WINTOUR combines wine tourism innovation, oenology and destination management across a Spanish-French-Portuguese consortium. Applications for the most recent cycle are closed, and the consortium will announce the next intake on its apply page — worth monitoring if you work in or study wine tourism.

Programme Highlights

  • Unique wine-tourism specialisation with vineyard-region mobility
  • Applications currently closed; next cycle announcement pending
  • Triple-degree tradition across the consortium universities
  • Graduates work in wine regions, tourism boards and hospitality innovation

Who Should Apply

Tourism, business, agriculture, food science and humanities graduates with an interest in wine regions are the natural applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships in past intakes: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the WINTOUR applications page for the next-cycle announcement and prepare documents per the previous call's checklist. Key deadline information: Applications closed for the current cycle — next intake to be announced on the official page.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About WINTOUR Consortium

The WINTOUR consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Wine Tourism Innovation with universities in Spain, France and Portugal and partners across Europe's wine regions.

Official website: https://www.wintour-master.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Next cycle to be announced - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
